subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving selective reply routing to existing message-tool policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but prompt-driven selective replies would change channel delivery policy and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep this issue or a follow-up open for a maintainer-approved API direction around channel-selective replies.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Selected Delivery
options.body: Document or confirm that reply routing remains host-controlled and model-selected channel delivery is not planned now.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and latest maintainer review comment make this the clearest owner for deciding command prompt scope versus delivery-policy scope.
